summary: Iter-106 verified Phase 5 ORAi Intelligence & Automation end-to-end. Backend pytest 34/34 pass (memory CRUD + audit + settings, recommendations, health 7-factor score, automations CRUD/validation/run-check, template full lifecycle, course sharing + import with creator credit, admin AI Command Center config/prompts/analytics/audit/providers/memory/automations/templates, intelligence overview with manager vs member gating, ORAi chat memory-injection reflects stored astronomy topic). Frontend flows on preview URL confirmed: /responsibility-center/{cid}/intelligence renders health ring (score 56, 'Needs Attention'), all 7 factors, 6 stat cards, 7-day trend, all 6 tabs; Suggestions tab shows 3 recs + Read aloud button; Memory tab add/pin/delete/export/toggle work with real backend round-trips; Automations tab New builder → trigger + notify_member action + save creates card, toggle + delete work; Drafts tab controls present (didn't LLM-call); Templates tab shows saved 'Solar system starter' card. Admin /admin/orai-control shows all 8 tabs, Provider Health shows 3 engines with green dots (no provider name leaks), Config save works, Analytics numeric. RC dashboard shows rc-dash-intelligence-btn alongside ORAi FAB. Course Studio /courses has course-share-1 + course-template-2 buttons; share modal opens with 3 visibility radios + confirm. Second center /courses shows 'Shared with this Center' section + shared-import button. CoursePlayer /learn route shows player-read-aloud-btn. Ed dashboard sidebar has 'Intelligence' text. tftwo member view correctly hides Memory/Automations/Drafts/Templates tabs — only Overview + Suggestions visible. No console errors beyond the expected 401 preflight noise on the /signin page (pre-login).

ui_bugs.issue: Save button click succeeded (config persisted per PUT /api/admin/orai/config test), but no visible toast/status element matched .toast/[role='status'] selectors after click. Users may not see confirmation. Consider adding a data-testid=orai-cfg-saved toast.
Audit list renders (data present via /api/admin/orai/audit) but individual rows do NOT have per-row data-testid (e.g. orai-audit-<id>). Adding row-level testids would help automation.

issues: Shared bottom mobile-nav (Home/For You/Sounds/Plus/Realms/Friends/Profile) still renders at 1440x900 desktop viewports (carry-over from iter-104/105). Not a Phase-5-specific regression but continues to be the click-through hazard for FABs/tutor-send/etc.

action_items: (nice-to-have) Add toast/data-testid=orai-cfg-saved status element on Admin AI Command Center after successful config save so the user (and automation) can confirm the save landed.
(nice-to-have) Add per-row data-testid to Audit log rows in Admin AI Command Center for automation robustness.
(carry-over from iter-104/105) Hide the mobile bottom nav on md+ viewports or raise z-index of floating actions so they aren't intercepted.
critical_code_review_comments: rc_intelligence.build_memory_context correctly respects orai_memory_enabled flag and injects pinned-first memory into ORAi chat prompts — verified end-to-end by TestOraiChat.test_chat_uses_memory reply containing space/astronomy keywords.
rc_intelligence.health_score always returns exactly 7 factors with positive weights summing to 1.0 (0.2+0.2+0.15+0.1+0.1+0.1+0.15). Fine. Label thresholds map to score correctly.
rc_intelligence permission gating: managers-only endpoints uniformly call _require_manager (403 for tftwo). Overview strips memory_count/drafts_pending for non-managers.

rc_automations.approve_run uses an atomic MongoDB filter {vault_balance:{$gte:amount}} + $inc:-amount to guard against overspend — good; on failure the pending action is marked ok:false 'Vault balance too low' without side-effects.
rc_automations.fire_trigger cleanly separates safe actions (executed) from award_fire_power (pending_actions queue). Every catch keeps other actions running. Good.
rc_courses.import_shared_course returns {course_id, credit} (not {course:{id}}); credit includes original_creator + original_center — verified in tests.
admin_orai config write is founder-only (write=True), reads are any-admin — matches spec. Audit doc inserted for every write.

MINOR: rc_intelligence.approve_draft — for 'task/reminder' path the created returns id via rc_items.create_item(...).get('item', item).get('id') — the shape assumption is fragile; consider always returning the created item id explicitly. Not a bug since only used for tracking.
